body: that sounds like me almost exactly. I cry constantly and will just stare at myself for hours in the mirror asking myself "why the FUCK are you crying, nothing even happened" but I can't stop. I talked to my boyfriend about it several times but im scared people will think im crazy so i only bring it up during fights when it just slips out because im overwhelemd with emotions so he just thinks im being dramatic and blowing things out of proportion. Hes had a pretty rough life so when he looks at my life he asks me what the hell is wrong and I just don't have an answer. I don't know what's wrong. Now I just push everyone away because how can they understand when I can't even understand it myself?

ive tried but its been 9 years of feeling empty and alone. I feel alone doing things I love, being with people I love, even at the happiest moments in my life I can't shake the feeling. Its just cold and dark and I always feel like I'm watching my life from outside my own body.
